headline: Approved up to $200,000 for bathroom repairs at Ella Risk Elementary School, and approved payments of $1,570,907.86 and $276,273.46.
summary: Updates covered the high school budget closeout, the track and field project, and the Dual Language Pre-K to 8th grade project. Track and field groundbreaking is set for November 17, 2026. The Ella Risk bathroom funding passed 9 to 1 after discussion of staff capacity.
decisions: Approved the October 14, 2026 meeting minutes as presented, with three abstentions.
Approved up to $200,000 for the first round of bathroom repairs at Ella Risk Elementary School, 9 votes in favor and 1 opposed.
Approved payments of $1,570,907.86 for Bond Series 2025 Requisition #6 and $276,273.46 for Facilities Opportunity Initiative Requisition #2.

decision_evidence.quote: A. Lynch made a motion to approve the minutes as presented, seconded by R. Marty No discussion. Abstentions: Buddy Comet, Jordana Ruggeri, Purnima Demorais All in favor

S. Friedman, on behalf of the subcommittee, requests authorization from the School Building Committee to spend up to $200,000 on the first round of bathroom repairs at Ella Risk Elementary School. ... The motion passed with 9 votes in favor and 1 vote opposed.

A. Lynch made a motion to bundle and approve the School Bond Series 2025 #6 for $1,570,907.86 and the Facilities Opportunity Initiative Requisition #2 for $276,273.46. B. Comet seconded the motion. No Discussion All In Favor
